comment: Playport's public compatibility list, shown by site/compatibility/index.html. A scrubbed summary of Linear project Compatibility (team PLA), one entry per title: no player names, IPA hashes, run paths or tracker links. Keep entries sorted by name; tools/tests/test_compat_site.py checks the format.

games.name: Among Us
games.notes: Crashes about 17 s after Play. Its online sign-in (through Epic Online Services) also fails a certificate check.

games.name: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon
games.notes: Does not start: the app closes, says the game cannot run, or shows a black screen. A 32-bit Direct3D 9 game.

games.name: Castle Crashers
games.notes: Does not start: the app closes, says the game cannot run, or shows a black screen. The same setup runs it on Madeira, so the fault is in Playport.

games.name: Cat Mail Co.
games.notes: Closes at once at launch, on Vulkan and on DXMT.

games.name: Catherine Classic
games.notes: Does not start: the app closes, says the game cannot run, or shows a black screen. A 32-bit Direct3D 9 game.

games.name: Counter-Strike
games.notes: "No Windows executable in this folder" after install. After that it needs OpenGL, which Playport does not have yet.

games.name: Death's Door
games.notes: Plays into the game, with an Epic sign-in. About 35 to 40 FPS, held back by the GPU, with some hitches.

games.name: DiRT 3 Complete Edition
games.notes: "Could not start". It is a 32-bit Direct3D 11 game, which Playport has no graphics backend for yet.

games.name: Duck Paradox
games.notes: Exits about a second after start.

games.name: En Garde!
games.notes: Plays, through DXMT, at 18 to 20 FPS (held back by the GPU at 720 rows). Its Direct3D 12 mode reaches only the splash screen.

games.name: Final Fantasy III (3D Remake)
games.notes: Closes at once at launch. It needs OpenGL, which Playport does not have yet.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade
games.notes: About 30 FPS most of the time at 900p, textures and shadows Low, Vulkan. Stutters the first time it loads new assets, and the sound is not right.

games.name: Geometry Dash
games.notes: Closes when opened. It needs OpenGL, which Playport does not have yet.

games.name: Half-Life
games.notes: "No Windows executable in this folder" after install. After that it needs OpenGL, which Playport does not have yet.

games.name: Hollow Knight
games.notes: Menus and gameplay at 60 FPS at 720 rows, about 120 FPS uncapped, on Vulkan or DXMT. Keep the game page's Disk cache Off (the default): with it On, warm starts crash.

games.name: House of Golf 2
games.notes: Installs, then stops at its Visual C++ runtime installer before the game starts.

games.name: Jurassic World Evolution
games.notes: Exits at once: its program must load at a fixed address the runtime already uses.

games.name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance
games.notes: Plays from the menu into Rattay at about 29 FPS on the lowest settings, through DXMT. Long loads (about 95 s to the menu), and it uses nearly all of an 8 GB memory limit: it needs Increased Memory Limit.

games.name: Monster Train
games.notes: Starts, but the picture stays black. GOG sign-in works.

games.name: Moonscars
games.notes: Reaches the title screen and signs in to GOG. Gameplay not checked yet.

games.name: Mortal Kombat Komplete Edition
games.notes: Does not start: the app closes, says the game cannot run, or shows a black screen. A 32-bit Direct3D 9 game.

games.name: MultiVersus
games.notes: With -dx12 (Direct3D 12 on Vulkan): menus and local Training at 26 to 31 FPS. Online modes are gone (the servers closed in 2025). The default Direct3D 11 mode is not tested.

games.name: Need for Speed: The Run
games.notes: Black screen. It needs EA's launcher, and it is a 32-bit Direct3D 11 game, which Playport has no graphics backend for yet.

games.name: Oxygen Not Included
games.notes: Reaches the menus, then crashes when creating a world.

games.name: Portal 2
games.notes: About 60 FPS at 720p, Direct3D 9 through Vulkan, with both portals, sound, a controller, saves and Steam Cloud. A black screen is reported on an iPhone 16e inside LiveContainer.

games.name: Shogun Showdown
games.notes: Installs and updates from GOG and reaches the title screen. Gameplay not checked yet.

games.name: Snakebird Complete
games.notes: Reaches the main menu, with Epic Online Services sign-in. Gameplay past the menu not checked yet.

games.name: Soccer Online: Ball 3D
games.notes: Runs, but no picture: most likely a settings window the phone does not show.

games.name: South Park: The Stick of Truth
games.notes: Does not start: the app closes, says the game cannot run, or shows a black screen. The same setup runs it on Madeira, so the fault is in Playport.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
games.notes: Closes at once at launch. It needs OpenGL, which Playport does not have yet.

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.notes: The classic 1.32 build (Steam branch "classic") plays at its 30 FPS cap, through DXMT. The current build does not start: it needs AVX, which Playport's x86 translator does not offer.

games.name: Valheim
games.notes: With the game page's graphics set to DXMT: its intro plays and Steam online sign-in works; the main menu and gameplay are not checked yet. On Vulkan it crashed in the intro; a fix is in, not yet checked with this game.
